title: Cross-cutting guardrails need backlinks from design docs
observation: A standalone note about outsourcing legal guardrails is easier to miss during implementation unless the relevant workflow and access-control design docs link to it directly.
impact: Adding backlinks from the authoritative design docs makes legal and terminology constraints much more likely to influence future implementation and review decisions.
candidate_rule: When adding a cross-cutting guardrail note, also add explicit references from the design documents where the rule changes implementation decisions.
evidence: The new outsourcing guardrail note only became part of the normal reading path after links were added to work-record and access-control docs
The project already relies on document reading order and SSOT references to shape implementation behavior
